text: For types using MessagePackObject(SuppressSourceGeneration = true), should all MsgPack0xx rules remain active, or only rules governing the runtime serialization contract?
options: Only runtime-contract rules are required; keep MsgPack011, MsgPack016, and MsgPack017 suppressed for these types, as the README states.
Every MsgPack0xx rule remains active, so non-partial declarations and AOT-related violations must still be diagnosed even though no formatter is generated.
why_it_matters: The first answer makes the documented exclusions intentional, although the reported MsgPack003 and MsgPack005 gaps remain defects. The second answer makes those exclusions an additional requirement gap and requires implementation changes for MsgPack011, MsgPack016, and MsgPack017.
